commit_scope: Heal every reproducible internal web 404 by routing the two unshipped ontology child URLs to their existing working contribution and statistics surfaces, then guard the complete literal and localized-markdown link corpus against future route drift.
evidence_refs: Public breadth-first crawl: 1,200 reachable HTML pages checked; the only 404 was Cloudflare's synthetic /cdn-cgi/l/email-protection endpoint, while direct probes confirmed /ontology/contribute and /ontology/stats were the two genuine application 404s.

Static route inventory: all 133 concrete App Router pages returned below 400 in production; repository-wide literal href/navigation analysis isolated exactly the two ontology misses; all localized markdown links resolved against the route tree.
Local production build: npm run build passed and emitted the full Next.js route manifest.
Local tests: npm test passed 24 files and 143 tests, including the new repository-wide internal-page-links band (3/3).
Local HTTP proof: both retired ontology URLs return 308 and their final targets return 200; the rendered ontology page emits /concepts/garden#share directly.
In-app Chromium proof: the Share an idea CTA navigated to /concepts/garden#share with the contribution form visible; both retired URLs landed on their named, visible anchor targets.

commands: browser navigation and visible-target checks for both redirects and the ontology CTA
local_validation.notes: All implementation and route checks pass. The standalone Playwright suite could not launch because its separately cached Chromium binary was absent; downloading that optional 171 MiB binary stalled at 0%, so equivalent local browser behavior was proven through the available in-app Chromium surface.

ci_validation.notes: No remote CI run has been created yet.

deploy_validation.notes: The public site still carries the pre-change deployment until this branch lands and the normal deployment flow completes.

e2e_validation.expected_behavior_delta: Visitors and old bookmarks no longer receive 404 for /ontology/contribute or /ontology/stats; both converge on the already-working contribution form or ontology statistics, and current ontology links point directly to those canonical targets.
test_flows: Open /ontology and follow Share an idea to a visible #share contribution form.
Open each retired ontology child URL and observe permanent redirect plus visible named target.
Scan literal application navigation and localized markdown links against App Router pages, route handlers, public assets, and declared redirects.
e2e_validation.notes: Local browser and HTTP flows pass; public post-deploy verification remains represented by deploy_validation=pending.
